acceptance: Canonical chain verification, fork-anchor resolution (resolveAnchor), cycle detection (detectAnchorCycle), marker validation (validateForestMarker), and signed-era forest verification (checkForestSignedEra, verifyManifestForest) live in packages/tickets/lib/manifest-primitives.mjs with manifest-segments.mjs and gate-manifest/lib/{forest,verify}.mjs delegating to it.

All newly written signed segment entries (seq >= 1) in packages/tickets/lib/evidence.mjs and packages/ticket-sync/lib/reassign.mjs carry sigVersion: 2 and verify under signV2 while historical v1 entries continue to verify.

TicketService.planReconciliation enforces #assertNoManifestRails and #assertRailsExist on newly introduced rails and sets evidenceRequired when tickets are deleted (excluding pure renames where a new id is added without dropping contract coverage? No: verify exact existing ticket-sync/push tests and enforce deletion evidence!).
Cursor bundles are rebuilt in lockstep and packages/tickets, packages/gate-manifest, packages/ticket-sync, workspace-deps-declared, and ticket-store-boundary tests plus full npm run preflight pass.
body: Implement Wave 2 T-P14a: (1) Consolidate canonical chain, fork-anchor (resolveAnchor, detectAnchorCycle), and .store.json auth=keyed forest verification downward into packages/tickets/lib/manifest-primitives.mjs, delegating both packages/tickets/lib/manifest-segments.mjs and packages/gate-manifest/lib/{forest,verify}.mjs to that single implementation; (2) Sign all newly written seq >= 1 segment entries with signV2 (sigVersion: 2) in packages/tickets/lib/evidence.mjs and packages/ticket-sync/lib/reassign.mjs while preserving backward-compatible verification of historical v1 entries; (3) Enforce #assertNoManifestRails, #assertRailsExist, and deletion evidence inside TicketService.planReconciliation in packages/tickets/lib/service.mjs, and rebuild Cursor bundles.
title: Wave 2: Downward forest-verifier consolidation, universal signV2, and planReconciliation invariants (T-P14a)
